nodes.name: 42-loc
nodes.description: Greedy rectangular partition of a coarse 2-4 grid, each region flood-filled with a random chromotome color over a stroke ground
nodes.notable: Whole sketch is deliberately kept to roughly 42 lines of code

nodes.name: breaking-down
nodes.description: Recursive binary subdivision of a square into alternating two-tone rectangles with white borders over a faint grid
nodes.notable: Split rectangles held in a tree; each new child flips between fg and bg

nodes.name: breaking-down-complimentary
nodes.description: Binary square subdivision like breaking-down but colored with a complementary RYB hue pair, no borders and a finer grid
nodes.notable: Two complementary hues (h and h+180) instead of the fg/bg two-tone

nodes.name: anni-albers
nodes.description: Grid of woven cells in fill or stripe mode, progressively revealed top-to-bottom; contrast-filtered color pairs recall an Anni Albers silk tapestry
nodes.notable: Reveal driven by playhead sweeping a cell-count limit

nodes.name: anni-weaving
nodes.description: Woven warp/weft grid using one randomly chosen weave draft (twill, herringbone, houndstooth, satin, waffle, monk's belt...) animating its shed offset
nodes.notable: Ten interlacement drafts share one (c,r,offset) boolean pattern signature

nodes.name: chunky
nodes.description: Woven warp/weft grid where each column and row draws its own hue from two oklch ramps; background lightness auto-chosen for WCAG contrast
nodes.notable: Per-thread color from oklch ramps; bg derived from a relative-luminance contrast calc

nodes.name: heerich
nodes.description: Weave draft painted onto the six faces of a 3D grid of boxes, rendered as oblique faces via the Heerich engine with the camera rotating
nodes.notable: Warp/weft/depth patterns each drive a different cube face - a woven volume

nodes.name: heerich-depth
nodes.description: Weave draft extruded into a relief - warp cells raised, weft cells flat - rendered as oblique edge-shaded boxes via Heerich
nodes.notable: Height field from the weave pattern; face edges lightened/darkened from fill luminance

nodes.name: heerich-plotter
nodes.description: Plotter-ready SVG of a weave draft extruded as oblique white boxes with black outlines, scaled to an A4 page via Heerich
nodes.notable: Exports plotter SVG through Heerich.toSVG with a physical A4 viewBox

nodes.name: moori
nodes.description: Vertical bands split into weave/solid/stripe cells drawn as bundles of thin warp/weft fibers, in Albers-inspired earthy palettes
nodes.notable: Fiber mode renders each thread as several hairlines for textile grain

nodes.name: signal
nodes.description: Coarse grid of large flat oklch color planes where the weave pattern decides warp/weft dominance per cell; a hard-edged color field
nodes.notable: Weave logic repurposed as hard-boundary color-field composition

nodes.name: signal-2
nodes.description: Near-monochrome oklch weave grid interrupted by a single accent column and row - one bright pop against a dominant color
nodes.notable: One accent warp plus one accent weft make a single chromatic interruption

nodes.name: weaves
nodes.description: Full-canvas woven field of warp/weft fiber hairlines using a chosen weave draft, then displaced by a per-pixel Perlin noise warp
nodes.notable: Post-process noise displacement distorts the finished weave like slack fabric

nodes.name: automata-dither
nodes.description: Elementary 1D cellular-automaton rows scrolling upward, colored per rule, then downsampled and Atkinson-dithered
nodes.notable: Wolfram rule (156/135/214...) drawn in color, then Atkinson dithered

nodes.name: basic
nodes.description: Elementary 1D cellular automaton from a random seed row, generations scrolling upward as colored square cells
nodes.notable: Rule lookup uses an inverted index (7 - index)

nodes.name: xor-game-of-life
nodes.description: Conway's Game of Life on a toroidal grid whose state changes XOR-accumulate into a display buffer with a fading decay trail
nodes.notable: XORs the transitions between GoL frames, not the live cells themselves

nodes.name: xor-game-of-life-trail
nodes.description: Same XOR Game-of-Life interference field as xor-game-of-life, but decay trails are colored from a pro-color-harmonies palette
nodes.notable: Decay counter indexes into the palette to color the trail

nodes.name: xortomata
nodes.description: Elementary cellular automaton whose display XORs the rule output with the cell's own state, drawn as black cells on white and scrolling
nodes.notable: Random rule 0-255 each run; XOR of the rule bit with the center cell

nodes.name: grid-construction
nodes.description: Generative Bauhaus poster: a structural line anchors filled circles, semicircles, triangles and quarter-circles on a grid, with BAUHAUS set in negative space
nodes.notable: Places the word into the largest empty grid strip found via an occupancy scan

nodes.name: nalee-composition
nodes.description: Bauhaus-style poster where clipped grid regions are filled by nalee space-filling walkers in contrasting color pairs, with Staatliches type
nodes.notable: nalee walkers clipped to grid rectangles act as poster color blocks

nodes.name: nalee-composition-2
nodes.description: Variant of nalee-composition with more, smaller clipped nalee blocks spread across the grid, plus Staatliches title and date
nodes.notable: Five clipped nalee regions instead of two for a busier poster layout

nodes.name: truchet
nodes.description: Grid of tiles each with nested corner-anchored circles alternating by cell parity (Truchet-like), rampensau colors and a Staatliches caption
nodes.notable: Concentric discs pinned to alternating tile corners read as Truchet tiles

nodes.name: bio-sprue
nodes.description: Neon glow motifs on a vignetted near-black ground: a stepped pink rail, a rung helix, a shaded rounded cross and a vesicle cluster, grained
nodes.notable: Style study for the series: every motif is drawn with the shared glow-style module (blurred halo, banded core, specular highlight)

nodes.name: nalee
nodes.description: Nalee walkers on a coarse 12x12 domain rendered as pink, purple and blue neon tubes over a vignetted near-black ground with film grain
nodes.notable: Tube width is decoupled from the grid pitch, so the same nalee walk reads as sparse neon signage rather than a dense fill

nodes.name: sprue
nodes.description: Neon nalee tubes inside a glowing pink sprue frame; stepped gate nubs bond tube ends to the rail and dead-end tips to neighbouring tubes
nodes.notable: Treats the nalee output as a model-kit sprue: connectors only bridge to stable anchors so no gate ever hangs off another bare tip

nodes.name: basic
nodes.description: Bipolar coordinate diagram: families of constant-tau and constant-sigma circles drawn blue and red about two focal points on white
nodes.notable: Constant-coordinate curves of a bipolar system are two orthogonal circle families

nodes.name: colors
nodes.description: The bipolar circle families filled as nested flat discs sorted large-to-small, cycling through an auto-albers palette as they animate
nodes.notable: Solid nested discs from bipolar coordinates create a moire-like concentric field

nodes.name: spiral
nodes.description: A single spiral plotted in bipolar coordinates between two foci, stroked as gradient-colored line segments from an auto-albers palette.
nodes.notable: Uses a bipolar (two-focus) coordinate transform via sinh/cosh to warp the spiral, not the usual polar r=theta.

nodes.name: spiral-animated
nodes.description: Bipolar-coordinate spiral that rotates continuously as sigma is twisted by the playhead; gradient stroke mirrored around its midpoint.
nodes.notable: Looping twist derived directly from playhead so the spiral spins seamlessly over one cycle.

nodes.name: spiral-jiggly
nodes.description: Rotating bipolar-coordinate spiral with per-point Perlin-noise jitter, giving the gradient line a trembling, hand-drawn wobble.
nodes.notable: Noise offset is modulated by sin(playhead) so the jitter breathes in and out across the loop.

nodes.name: spiral-pattern
nodes.description: Bipolar coordinate grid of hyperbolic and circular arcs overlaid with a twisting spiral drawn as tiny plus/cross tick marks.
nodes.notable: Draws the underlying bipolar coordinate grid (constant-tau and constant-sigma curves) as faint scaffolding under the spiral.

nodes.name: black-on-black
nodes.description: Canvas greedily split into rectangular regions, each folded into three faceted quads shaded in near-black P3 greys on pure black.
nodes.notable: Barely-there tonal separations (display-p3 greys 0.05-0.2) so facets read only as subtle folds on black.

nodes.name: blinds
nodes.description: Grid-quantized rects placed greedily for moment balance and one deep void; each a clipped window with harmony-palette panels sliding through
nodes.notable: The layout scorer penalizes mid-distance gutters and rewards a single deep void, so whitespace is designed rather than leftover

nodes.name: collapse
nodes.description: Fork of blinds: placed rects fall toward the centre until flush, a seal pass closes every lane gap, a tinted backdrop shrink-wraps the pack
nodes.notable: Two-stage gravity: a no-overlap slide toward the centre, then an overlap-permitted seal so no notch survives anywhere in the mass

nodes.name: cohesion-color
nodes.description: Quadtree-accelerated flocking where each boid's color is the OKLCH-weighted average of its neighbors, leaving gradient trails and triangle heads.
nodes.notable: Neighbor hues averaged as sin/cos vectors to handle wrap-around, so color spreads contagiously through the flock.

nodes.name: gradient
nodes.description: Classic Reynolds flocking of 128 boids leaving gradient-faded trails with triangular heads, wrapping at the canvas edges.
nodes.notable: Brute-force O(n^2) neighbor checks; trails fade out near the end of the loop for a clean export cycle.

nodes.name: gradient-quadtree
nodes.description: Reynolds flocking scaled to ~900 boids using a d3-quadtree for neighbor lookups, drawing gradient trails and triangular heads.
nodes.notable: Quadtree rebuilt each frame with radius-visit culling to make the large flock tractable at 1920x1080.

nodes.name: noise-field-color
nodes.description: Quadtree flocking whose trail colors are sampled from a Perlin noise field, then the whole frame is downscaled and Atkinson-dithered.
nodes.notable: Palette sorted by OKLCH hue and mapped through a low-frequency noise field, giving zonal color; final pass is atkinson dither.

nodes.name: pipe
nodes.description: Boids whose headings snap to 45-degree increments and step across a fixed grid, drawing pipe-like right-angled trails with square heads.
nodes.notable: Velocity heading snapped to PI/4 and advanced by one grid step so the flock reads as circuit-board pipework.

nodes.name: robert-swain
nodes.description: Two layers of colored rectangles whose overlaps are repainted in inverted colors, a boolean intersection over a Robert Swain palette.
nodes.notable: Overlap regions filled with rybitten-inverted colors so intersections invert the base swatch beneath them.

nodes.name: chill-wave
nodes.description: Looping dashed sine-like stroke built from cubic segments, wiped on the right by a paper mask; hue, weight and amplitude set by sliders
nodes.notable: Dash length is measured from an SVG path's getTotalLength so the dash rhythm tracks the amplitude slider exactly

nodes.name: controls-demo
nodes.description: Five-point star with independently rounded convex and concave corners, shown filled, as a ring, or as a wireframe with vertex nodes
nodes.notable: The reference sketch for the canvas-UI shell: modes, sliders, hatch-on-magnify and the loupe all exercised on one shape

nodes.name: curve-relief
nodes.description: Four stacked relief fills, each a matter-js spring chain hung between grid corners and settling under gravity; draggable seed points
nodes.notable: Ports the original's OKLCH clamp on purpose: L=100 c=70 is out of gamut and the channel clamp turns it into a saturated hue

nodes.name: torsions
nodes.description: Seven blocks hanging from the top edge, each twisted about its vertical axis; front, back and edge faces filled from a Mindful palette
nodes.notable: Front/back faces come from intersecting the outer bezier of one edge with the inner bezier of the other and splitting both at t

nodes.name: chaikin-paths
nodes.description: Horizontal ribbons of Chaikin-smoothed paths animated by a marching line-dash offset that draws and erases each band in turn.
nodes.notable: Path length measured via an offscreen SVG path element to drive lineDashOffset, so strokes appear to draw themselves.

nodes.name: chaotic-pendulums
nodes.description: 25 nested double pendulums of increasing arm length simulated from the equations of motion, tracing chaotic looping trails that fade.
nodes.notable: Semi-transparent background fill leaves ghost trails; length-ramped pendulums fan the chaos into a layered rosette.

nodes.name: ascii
nodes.description: Chladni plate nodal field sampled on a grid and rendered as an ASCII heatmap of glyphs, dark-to-light, in the jgs7 pixel font.
nodes.notable: Closed-form Chladni equation quantized to six characters (space to @) so nodal lines emerge as text density.

nodes.name: basic
nodes.description: 10k particles random-walk with amplitude driven by a Chladni equation, migrating onto the nodal lines; optional greyscale heatmap.
nodes.notable: Stochastic amplitude proportional to the Chladni value pushes particles toward zero-crossings, a physical-sand analogy.

nodes.name: layered
nodes.description: Four overlaid Chladni particle systems, each with its own m/n frequencies and palette color, settling into interleaved nodal patterns.
nodes.notable: Layering four independent frequency modes builds a moire of competing nodal sets in different colors.

nodes.name: strokes
nodes.description: Chladni particles migrate a few steps leaving tapered, smoothed brush strokes across four colored systems; optional Atkinson dither.
nodes.notable: Trails turned into filled tapered ribbons via polyline-normals with quadratic width easing for calligraphic ends.

nodes.name: trail
nodes.description: Chladni particles drawn as short smoothed trail paths across four colored systems, post-processed with Atkinson dithering.
nodes.notable: Noise-driven walk (not pure random) plus a downscale-and-dither pass gives the nodal streaks a printed, grainy texture.

nodes.name: circle-pack
nodes.description: 2D circle packing via pack-spheres, rendered only as concentric circle outlines centered on the canvas over a dark generated ground.
nodes.notable: Split-complementary rampensau palettes and spiral scaffolding are prepared but the render is stuck in debug outline-only mode.

nodes.name: animated-stretch
nodes.description: A grid of plus-shaped textile motifs that stretch and contract through a looping sequence of x/y scale steps, like breathing weave.
nodes.notable: A hand-authored table of x/y stretch keyframes drives the motif's elastic breathing across the loop.

nodes.name: basic
nodes.description: Static woven-textile pattern built from four stacked layers of interlocking plus-shaped cells on a stepped grid.
nodes.notable: Each palette color is a distinct plus-motif layer with its own horizontal step, reading as a flat-weave swatch.

nodes.name: carousel
nodes.description: Woven plus-motif pattern animated by slicing the canvas with getImageData and cycling rows upward like a carousel.
nodes.notable: Scroll achieved by copying image-data slices and re-pasting them, at a deliberate 2fps for a mechanical loom feel.

nodes.name: pro-color-harmonies
nodes.description: Layered plus-motif textile pattern colored by a procedurally generated pro-color-harmonies palette in OKLCH.
nodes.notable: Same weave motif as clearloop/basic but recolored from random harmony schemes with sine/wave/zap modifiers.

nodes.name: robert-swain
nodes.description: Five-layer woven textile pattern scrolling vertically, colored with a Robert Swain field palette and a striped top/bottom border.
nodes.notable: The fifth layer indexes a 3x3 nested color grid, and the whole weave scrolls with a wrapped y-offset.

nodes.name: robert-swain-lights-on-off
nodes.description: Columns of stacked colored rectangles on a 15x15 grid scrolling vertically with wraparound; the palette inverts on click and mid-loop
nodes.notable: Palette can flip to a computed photographic negative via the rybitten invert util, toggled on click and at frame 120.

nodes.name: rybitten
nodes.description: Interlocking plus/cross motifs tiled across an 11x13 grid; hues rotate continuously through the loop
nodes.notable: Animation is pure hue rotation (+360*playhead) over the rybitten-generated palette; several alternate lerp schemes left commented.

nodes.name: stretch
nodes.description: A stretched rectangular window/frame motif tiled across a 13x15 grid over a light ground

nodes.name: animated-shape
nodes.description: A single Clixo-toy form (rounded clover with corner rings) opening and closing as its corners rotate
nodes.notable: Form is modeled on the Clixo magnetic toy; the open/close is done by rotating corner arcs and re-stitching sides with kappa-matched bezier curves.

nodes.name: criss-cross
nodes.description: Grid of Clixo clover forms in black and white placed by An+B modulo rules, with outlined negative-space forms interleaved

nodes.name: layers
nodes.description: Grid of Clixo clover forms in outline and fill layers arranged by modulo patterns, inset by a margin

nodes.name: noise
nodes.description: Dense 21x21 grid of Clixo clover forms whose base color is chosen by sampling a low-frequency 2D noise field

nodes.name: overlap
nodes.description: Grid of Clixo clover forms two-toned by column parity

nodes.name: shape
nodes.description: A single large Clixo clover form (rounded square with four corner rings) centered on the canvas
nodes.notable: The base form itself, built from eight stitched circle arcs plus corner rings and inner dots.

nodes.name: shifty
nodes.description: Grid of Clixo clover forms in three color layers placed by staggered An+B modulo rules

nodes.name: shifty-2
nodes.description: Grid of Clixo clover forms in four color layers keyed to row/column modulo combinations

nodes.name: shifty-3
nodes.description: Dense 21x21 grid of Clixo forms whose placement per layer is driven by random An+B modulo periods
nodes.notable: Each of four layers picks random modulo divisor and offset, so the composition is chance-driven.

nodes.name: stack-columns
nodes.description: Clixo clover forms stacked into vertical columns (every 4th column), two-toned by row parity with accent forms

nodes.name: stack-columns-animated
nodes.description: Clixo clover forms in vertical columns opening and closing as their corners rotate over the loop

nodes.name: basic
nodes.description: A single cluster grows outward from a seed by probabilistic neighbor accretion, rendered as shaded ascii blocks over a dotted grid
nodes.notable: Growth is revealed cell-by-cell with a per-glyph shuffle transition; neighbor color is chosen by weighted vote so clusters stay coherent.

nodes.name: circle-pack
nodes.description: Multiple accretion clusters seeded at packed-circle centers, each growing to its circle radius, drawn as shaded ascii blocks
nodes.notable: pack-spheres sets seed positions and per-cluster growth caps, so clusters fill roughly circular territories.

nodes.name: multi-horizontal
nodes.description: Six accretion clusters grow from random seeds via probabilistic neighbor spread, rendered as shaded ascii blocks over a dotted grid

nodes.name: multi-random
nodes.description: Six accretion clusters grow from random seeds to radius limits, resetting each loop; shaded ascii blocks over a dotted grid

nodes.name: multi-random-static
nodes.description: Six accretion clusters grown fully in a precompute pass, then rendered as a fixed field of shaded ascii blocks
nodes.notable: Growth runs to a stable state in an up-front while-loop, so every frame draws the same finished image (no reveal).

nodes.name: system-test
nodes.description: Test harness driving the shared cluster-growth accretion engine, rendering one grown field of shaded ascii blocks
nodes.notable: Only sketch in the folder that calls the extracted ./system createClusterSystem engine rather than inlining the growth logic.

nodes.name: basic
nodes.description: 24 convex polygons drift inward and bounce, with SAT collision resolution and wall reflections
nodes.notable: Spawn overlaps are resolved up front by nudging along the minimum translation vector before the animation starts.

nodes.name: basic-b&w
nodes.description: 24 convex polygons bounce and collide via SAT physics, drawn as white outlines on black

nodes.name: explode
nodes.description: Colliding polygons shatter into fragments built by k-means clustering and convex hulls of interior points
nodes.notable: On impact each polygon fractures: interior points are k-means clustered and hulled into convex shards that fly off with rotated velocity.

nodes.name: spaw-debug
nodes.description: Debug view of SAT spawn placement: 12 polygons resolve initial overlaps (flagged red) then bounce, using a self-contained SAT implementation
nodes.notable: Standalone copy of the SAT engine (not the shared SAT.ts); overlapping spawns are highlighted red to debug placement.

nodes.name: color-fractions
nodes.description: 8-row grid where each row splits into progressively more color slices, revealed by a staggered tween over black; alternate columns flip slice orientation
nodes.notable: rampensau oklch hue ramp; row n is cut into n+1 vertical slices, orientation flipping per column

nodes.name: color-quanta
nodes.description: Rows subdivided into strips of 8 color quanta drawn from two opposing hue ramps, revealed by a staggered vertical grow over black
nodes.notable: two rampensau ramps 240 degrees apart per row; sibling of color-fractions

nodes.name: color-traveller-canvas
nodes.description: Cross-fades between generated ascii cluster-growth frames via per-pixel interpolation with an x-staggered easing wipe
nodes.notable: renders 5 cluster-growth frames offscreen then morphs between them at the pixel level

nodes.name: color-traveller-images
nodes.description: Cross-fades between five pre-rendered PNG stills via per-pixel interpolation with an x-staggered easing wipe
nodes.notable: feeds the sketchbook's own dated PNG exports back in as source frames

nodes.name: grid
nodes.description: Complex-plane grid mapped through f(z)=z2 (or 1/z, exp, sin, ...), original grid on the left and its conformal deformation on the right
nodes.notable: coral/blue line families stay perpendicular after mapping, illustrating angle preservation

nodes.name: nalee
nodes.description: Nalee space-filling walker paths deformed through a conformal map (sin(z) default), stroked in a clrs palette on a matching ground
nodes.notable: marries the nalee walker engine with complex-function warping; tweakpane-driven

nodes.name: transforms
nodes.description: 3x3 catalogue of conformal maps, each cell showing a base grid deforming under z2, 1/z, exp, sin(z), cos(z), ln(z) and more
nodes.notable: small-multiples reference sheet of eight complex functions

nodes.description: Colored rectangles snapped to a 4x3 grid over a light ground, with a toggleable coral grid overlay
nodes.notable: rybitten RYB-space palette; button toggles the construction grid on/off

nodes.description: Tall thin colored bars snapped to an 8x6 grid with two dark bars seated in the grid gaps, over a warm ground
nodes.notable: uses a gap-aligned rect helper so bars sit inside the grid gutters

nodes.description: Tall thin colored bars on an 8x6 grid anchored by a white block, background tinted from the palette hue
nodes.notable: background derived from the palette's hue at max lightness

nodes.name: convex-hull-101
nodes.description: 50k random points repeatedly k-means clustered and peeled into nested convex-hull polygons, revealed in sequence over a color ramp
nodes.notable: peels the least-dense cluster's hull one at a time from a dense point cloud

nodes.name: css-color-ramp
nodes.description: oklch color-space swatch ramp sweeping lightness across x and hue down y, the hue rotating each frame
nodes.notable: raw exploration of the CSS oklch() color space

nodes.name: backdrop
nodes.description: Noise-steered particle trails seeded inside a shape mask (circle/rect/triangle/full), tapered/diffused strokes, atkinson-dithered when settled
nodes.notable: signed-noise rotation drives trails; final frame gets an atkinson dither pass

nodes.name: chunky
nodes.description: 40 thick noise-steered particle trails in two depth layers split by a translucent palette gradient panel, atkinson-dithered
nodes.notable: trails widen along their length; a gradient panel separates fore/back layers

nodes.name: crumble
nodes.description: Thick particle trails layered with a domain-warped noise mesh ('crumble') of colored gridlines, atkinson-dithered
nodes.notable: iterated noise-warp displaces a regular grid into a crumpled wireframe

nodes.name: crumble-chunky
nodes.description: Particle trails plus a warped noise mesh with filled quads, a bold onomatopoeia word stamped over, atkinson-dithered
nodes.notable: random comic-book word (BANG, POP, ...) stroked over the mesh in the highest-contrast palette color

nodes.name: crumble-chunky-gradient
nodes.description: Particle trails over a warped noise mesh whose quads are flooded with one palette gradient, atkinson-dithered
nodes.notable: gradient-filled quads instead of per-cell noise colors

nodes.name: crumble-chunky-gradient-mesh
nodes.description: Particle trails over a warped mesh with randomized warp params, gradient-filled quads and a stroked wireframe, atkinson-dithered
nodes.notable: warp count/falloff/gradient-direction all randomized per run

nodes.name: crumble-chunky-mesh
nodes.description: Particle trails over a warped noise mesh with per-cell noise-colored quads and a black wireframe, atkinson-dithered
nodes.notable: each mesh cell filled by sampling noise into the palette colormap

nodes.name: fibonacci
nodes.description: Four Fibonacci-proportioned rectangles (13/8/5/3) laid on a faint 24-unit grid, colored from a pro-color-harmonies palette
nodes.notable: rect sizes are consecutive Fibonacci numbers; folder nods to Max Bill's concrete-art tradition

nodes.name: fibonacci-blinds
nodes.description: Fibonacci-proportioned rectangles animated as clipped two-tone sliding blinds (one panel static) on a faint grid
nodes.notable: each panel is a clipped window of three sliding color bars; direction set by aspect ratio

nodes.name: console
nodes.description: Animated ascii block grid (full/dark/medium/light shade chars) printed to the browser devtools console with per-cell colored %c styling
nodes.notable: draws into the devtools console via console.log %c styling rather than the canvas

nodes.name: disco-color-fractions
nodes.description: 8-row grid with each row split into more color slices, hues cycling rapidly every few frames, slice orientation alternating per column
nodes.notable: disco variant of color-fractions; regenerates the hue ramp every 5 frames

nodes.name: 16x16
nodes.description: A 16x16 grid whose line positions jitter and interpolate between distorted states each cycle, with checkerboard cells filled black
nodes.notable: checkerboard on a breathing, distorting grid built from the domain-polygon region system

nodes.name: basic
nodes.description: Random rectangular grid partition with one region-cluster carved into a polygon 'island', outlined over filled parts; monochrome on white
nodes.notable: Base of the domain-polygon system: partitions a grid, then boolean-clips a polygon 'island' from a selection of cells

nodes.name: construction-distorted
nodes.description: Subdivided grid of colored rectangles whose row/column lines interpolate between randomly distorted states, making the grid breathe
nodes.notable: Animates by lerping each grid vertex between randomly offset column/row positions across cycles

nodes.name: construction-distorted-gap
nodes.description: Gapped grid of OKLCH-harmony-colored rectangles animating between distorted grid states, separated by thick background outlines
nodes.notable: Uses ColorPaletteGenerator harmonies in OKLCH; picks the lightest color as background

nodes.name: construction-in-white-and-black
nodes.description: Static subdivided grid where each rectangle is filled with a left-to-right linear gradient between palette colors

nodes.name: construction-in-white-and-black-distorted
nodes.description: Outlines only: distorted rectangular grid animating between warped row/column positions, black stroke on white

nodes.name: construction-in-white-and-black-uchu
nodes.description: Static subdivided grid of rectangles each filled with a horizontal gradient across uchu hues on a dark ground

nodes.name: construction-kelly-distorted
nodes.description: A few largest regions reduced to bold flat color blocks over a distorting grid; Ellsworth Kelly-style hard-edge reduction
nodes.notable: Keeps only the largest cells as color blocks; color source switches between uchu, chromotome, and random palettes

nodes.name: disorder
nodes.description: Domain color field rasterized into small tiles that shuffle positions and animate scattering then re-forming
nodes.notable: Reads back the rendered field via getImageData, samples each tile's center color, then lerps tiles between ordered and shuffled layouts

nodes.name: gradient-distorted
nodes.description: Distorted rectangular grid with each region filled by a horizontal gradient (uchu or random palette), animated over cycles

nodes.name: just-grid
nodes.description: Bare structural view of the domain partition: outlined rectangles over faint underlying grid lines, monochrome
nodes.notable: Exposes the raw scaffolding of the domain system with no fills

nodes.name: just-grid-rough-process
nodes.description: Mousedown steps the domain-system generator through its region-combining stages, drawn in a rough hand-sketched style
nodes.notable: Drives the generator one optimization step per click and renders with roughjs for a sketchy pencil look

nodes.name: sketch
nodes.description: Abstract rectangle partition reinterpreted as macOS desktop UI: windows with traffic-light buttons, toolbar, and vector-network nodes
nodes.notable: Maps domain regions onto fake app chrome — windows, buttons, toolbars — using Radix UI color scales

nodes.name: sketch-distort
nodes.description: Animated macOS-desktop reading of the partition: windows and UI parts warp as the grid distorts between cycles

nodes.name: sketch-gridlines
nodes.description: macOS-window rendering of the partition with visible grid lines and a quarter of regions promoted to windows

nodes.name: sketch-tessellated
nodes.description: Tessellated polygons tiling the domains, filled as button-like parts and animated over a distorting grid

nodes.name: with-colors
nodes.description: Colored polygon-island construction: regions and clipped parts filled from a random palette, with an optional figure/ground invert

nodes.name: domain-warping
nodes.description: Grid of dots displaced by iterated noise domain-warping, colored by a subtractive-color ramp; animated fBm-style flow
nodes.notable: Classic iterated domain-warping (position fed through successive noise offsets with falloff) rendered as a displaced dot field

nodes.name: basic
nodes.description: Interactive Coulomb electric-field: draggable +/- charges, a grid of field arrows, and traced flux lines with arrowheads on black
nodes.notable: Real Coulomb math with complex-number vectors; tweakpane controls to add/remove charges and trace flux

nodes.name: gradient
nodes.description: Interactive charge field with flux lines drawn as tapering variable-width ribbons, gradient-colored by the nearest particle
nodes.notable: Stroke width scales inversely with field magnitude — thick where sparse, thin where dense — for a flowing look

nodes.name: gradient-paint
